title: How is a Council of AI measurement verified?
question: How is a Council of AI measurement record verified?
answer: A Council of AI measurement record is verified the same way every signed board and engine-fix record in the estate is verified: the canonical body is hashed (sha256) and signed with Ed25519 by the holder of the published public key, then re-checked on demand. Verification proves two things - authorship (the holder of the key issued it) and integrity (nothing in the body was altered since signing). The path ahead is one primitive swap to ML-DSA-65 via liboqs for post-quantum posture. A record that lacks the signature is honestly labelled unsigned, never dressed as signed. That discipline is what keeps a measurement claim auditable rather than asserted.
ref: Council of AI signature layer (Ed25519; ML-DSA upgrade path), verified on this node 2026-08-14
